## Continuation Rules

- Reload openspec/changes/deck-go-contract-chain-audit-and-real-e2e-foundation/proposal.md, design.md, tasks.md, specs/\*_/_.md, verification.yaml, this JSON matrix, and the generated Markdown report before acting after compaction or resume.
- Explore Gateway support, Deck-facing product design, source authority, generated drift, BFF ownership, frontend facade usage, and E2E evidence before deciding or implementing unclear contract-chain work.
- Directly fix deterministic P0 drift only when code truth, source authority, and verification path are clear; otherwise record the item in decisionIndex or proposalMatrix.
- Use existing Gateway contracts as the default authority. Do not assume new Gateway API, method, or event additions unless a separate Gateway evolution proposal is explicitly approved.
- Treat seed-covered L2 evidence as shared connectivity evidence only. It is not module-specific real Gateway proof.

## Source Paths

### activity.control-projection

- Gateway support basis: Runtime lifecycle, activity monitor, and monitor run projections are derived from Gateway/session events exposed by deck-go.
- Gateway source: `src/gateway/server-methods/describe.ts`
- Deck source: `deck-go/backend/internal/runtime/projection/sessions.go`, `deck-go/backend/internal/server/activity_monitor.go`
- Go adapter/BFF: `deck-go/backend/internal/runtime/openclaw/managed_runtime.go`, `deck-go/backend/internal/server/server.go`, `/api/activity`, `/api/monitor/runs`, `/api/monitor/stats`
- Contract source: `deck-go/contracts/source/deck-api.contract.ts`, `deck-go/contracts/source/deck-streams.contract.json`, `deck-go/contracts/source/deck-live-projections.contract.json`, `deck-go/contracts/source/deck-list-queries.contract.json`
- Generated artifacts: `deck-go/contracts/generated/ts/deck-api.generated.ts`, `deck-go/backend/internal/deckapi/types.generated.go`, `deck-go/contracts/generated/ts/deck-live-projections.generated.ts`, `deck-go/contracts/generated/ts/deck-list-queries.generated.ts`
- Frontend facade: `deck-go/frontend-new/src/api.ts`, `deck-go/frontend-new/src/api-types.ts`, `deck-go/frontend-new/src/hooks/useLiveProjectionSubscription.ts`, `deck-go/frontend-new/src/lib/list-query-contract.ts`
- Panel surface: `deck-go/frontend-new/src/components/panels/activity/ActivityPanel.tsx`, `deck-go/frontend-handoff/modules/activity/implementation-notes.md`

### agents.control-surface

- Gateway support basis: Gateway exposes agents._ plus deck.agents._ read/action methods; deck-go adapts them into BFF views and command wrappers.
- Gateway source: `src/gateway/server-methods/agents.ts`, `src/gateway/server-methods/deck/agents.ts`
- Deck source: `deck-go/backend/internal/server/inventory.go`, `deck-go/backend/internal/runtime/openclaw/contract_adapters.go`
- Go adapter/BFF: `deck-go/backend/internal/runtime/openclaw/gateway_queries.go`, `deck-go/backend/internal/server/inventory.go`, `/api/deck/agents`, `/api/agents/{agentId}/files`, `/api/agents/{agentId}/identity`
- Contract source: `deck-go/contracts/source/deck-api.contract.ts`, `deck-go/contracts/source/deck-exceptions.contract.json`, `deck-go/contracts/source/deck-mutations.contract.json`
- Generated artifacts: `deck-go/contracts/generated/ts/deck-api.generated.ts`, `deck-go/contracts/generated/ts/gateway/protocol.ts`, `deck-go/backend/internal/deckapi/types.generated.go`, `deck-go/backend/internal/gateway/generated/methods.go`, `deck-go/contracts/generated/ts/deck-mutations.generated.ts`
- Frontend facade: `deck-go/frontend-new/src/api.ts`, `deck-go/frontend-new/src/api-types.ts`, `deck-go/frontend-new/src/lib/mutation-evidence.ts`
- Panel surface: `deck-go/frontend-new/src/components/panels/agents/AgentsPanel.tsx`, `deck-go/frontend-handoff/modules/agents/implementation-notes.md`

### alerts.local-policy

- Gateway source: `src/gateway/server-methods/usage.ts`
- Deck source: `deck-go/backend/internal/server/alerts.go`
- Go adapter/BFF: `deck-go/backend/internal/server/alerts.go`, `deck-go/backend/internal/server/server.go`, `/api/alerts`, `/api/alerts/{ruleId}`
- Contract source: `deck-go/contracts/source/deck-api.contract.ts`, `deck-go/contracts/source/deck-endpoints.contract.json`, `deck-go/contracts/source/deck-mutations.contract.json`
